textual.context: The supplied records use promotional language. The ASR presents the earnings statement as a story about another person, while the title and description directly promote joining; whether the claims are endorsed, demonstrated, or otherwise qualified is unclear.
textual.potential_relevance: A promised earning or financial outcome is connected to the requested actions of joining Forsage and contacting a WhatsApp number, creating a specific reward-action relationship for later context assessment.
textual.limitations: These records do not establish that the earning claims are accurate, that any money was received or lost, what joining entails, or what information or payment—if any—would be requested through WhatsApp. No external destination, transaction, identity, or outcome was verified.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes Forsage as providing a 100% earning outcome and directs viewers who want to join to contact a WhatsApp number. It also presents an example of substantial earnings and shows dashboard profit figures alongside partner and team counts, reinforcing the participation-and-return promotion. The frames do not show the joining terms or any completed transaction.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The speaker presents reported earnings together with the person's direct-member count, while the displayed program screen pairs a profits figure with partner and team counts. This supports a recruitment-structure earning mechanism, though the inputs do not establish its payout rules.
